name: gakki
description: Implement frontends with Codex using exact design inspection, reusable assets and real render feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Build real pages with precise visual feedback.
interface.longDescription: GAKKI connects Codex design understanding with project-native implementation, deterministic assets and actual browser/iOS render evidence. Local tools require no separate model account.
defaultPrompt: 用 GAKKI 把这张设计稿实现到当前项目，运行页面并修正关键差异。
用 GAKKI 找出当前页面的布局问题，直接修复并复验。
用 GAKKI 整理这些静态素材，保留动态内容并适配项目倍率。
